text: What can the bot that sells your Mon do, if somebody takes it over?
cap: What can the bot that sells your MON do, if somebody takes it over?

text: On this plan, nothing I did not sign. So first, I write the plan.
cap: On this plan, nothing I did not sign. So first, I write the plan.

text: Three lines. Two stops, which sell if Mon falls to the line. One target, which sells if it rises to it.
cap: Three lines. Two stops sell if MON falls to the line. One target sells if it rises to it.

text: The target is still above today's price, so I pull it just under, and the keeper should sell it right away.
cap: I pull the target just under today's price, so the keeper should sell it right away.

text: Every line carries a floor, the lowest price the keeper may ever accept.
cap: Every line carries a floor: the lowest price the keeper may accept.

text: I need a wallet. A pass key is the wallet, so there is no extension and no seed phrase.
cap: A passkey is the wallet. No extension, no seed phrase.

text: The page sends me a little testnet Mon, and one pass key prompt signs the whole plan.
cap: A little testnet MON, then one passkey prompt signs the whole plan.

text: That single signature sets the Mon aside, upgrades my address, and arms the plan on Monad.
cap: One signature: MON set aside, address upgraded, plan armed on Monad.

text: Now I watch. The keeper reads the price, and my target line is already reached.
cap: The keeper watches the price. My target line is already reached.

text: It sells exactly the amount I signed, once.
cap: It sells exactly the amount I signed, once.

text: I do not trust the page, so I read the sale back from the chain. Status success, and the proceeds landed at my own address.
cap: Read back from the chain: status success, proceeds at my own address.

text: The two stops sit far below the price. Nothing else sold.
cap: The two stops sit far below the price. Nothing else sold.

text: That is the whole loop: write the plan, sign once, watch the keeper, and try to break it.
cap: The whole loop: write the plan, sign once, watch the keeper, try to break it.

text: Now the bad day. Assume the keeper is hacked, and it tries to cheat.
cap: The bad day: the keeper is hacked and tries to cheat.

text: First, a sale before the price has reached my line.
cap: 1. Sell before the price reaches my line.

text: Second, send the proceeds to the keeper itself.
cap: 2. Send the proceeds to the keeper.

text: Third, a fill after the end date. The timestamp caveat refuses that too.
cap: 3. Fill after the end date: refused by the timestamp caveat.

text: Each one is a real transaction on Monad testnet, mined with status zero, and the reason is read from the receipt, not from the page.
cap: Each is a real transaction, mined with status 0. The reason comes from the receipt.

text: Here is why nobody can cheat. The plan is a MetaMask delegation with two caveats: trip wire's own enforcer, and a timestamp.
cap: The plan is a MetaMask delegation with two caveats: tripwire's enforcer and a timestamp.

text: The enforcer runs inside every redemption, on Monad. It checks the line, the floor, the amount, and the recipient.
cap: The enforcer runs inside every redemption, on Monad: line, floor, amount, recipient.

text: Off chain, the keeper only watches the price, and asks Monad's own gas estimate before it sends anything.
cap: Off chain, the keeper only watches the price and asks Monad's gas estimate first.

text: The site itself is a static export with no server functions, so the only live process off chain is the keeper.
cap: The site is a static export with no server functions. Only the keeper runs off chain.

text: When I am done, one transaction revokes the plan.
cap: When I am done, one transaction revokes the plan.

text: And the chain confirms it: the plan is disabled, so nothing can fill it again.
cap: The chain confirms it: the plan is disabled and cannot be filled again.

text: Let a bot sell for you. The chain makes sure it only makes the sale you signed.
cap: Let a bot sell for you. The chain makes sure it only makes the sale you signed.

text: Open the live site, sign a plan, and press make it try.
cap: tripwire-three.vercel.app
